summary: Every hard rule holds across the four scored projects. Every scored project had a full lens review inside the last seven days (Rising 2026-10-05, Apothecary 2026-10-07, Everything 2026-10-08, Gnosis 2026-10-10), so this pass carries their scores forward and re-verifies every open action against the code instead of re-running the fan-out. Open actions fell from four to three: the Apothecary dev-log post landed and the Everything homepage now marks paused projects as stalled. Rising keeps the portfolio at in-progress, with its enemy spawn loop still unwired five days before the D-OPEN-50 default executes on 2026-10-16. The oldest item on the board is still the personal-skills upload in the desktop app, which only Kane can click, and the snapshot it would fix has drifted further since last week.
